name: Age of Awakening
source:
This is a visual novel recapping some of the events of a D&D campaign that the author had been playing in. This particular installment explains their character's backstory and introduces a few other characters.

[Edited from [url=https://draite.itch.io/age-of-awakening]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这部视觉小说回顾了作者参与的一场《龙与地下城》跑团中的部分事件。本篇主要讲述作者所扮演角色的过往，并介绍其他几位角色。

[编译自[url=https://draite.itch.io/age-of-awakening]itch.io[/url]]
